slides.title: Wispr Flow
slides.narration: A ninety-second guide to Wispr Flow, from the AiGovOps Foundation and the NCW AI Camp.

slides.title: What it is
lines: Wispr Flow is a dictation tool that lets you speak into any app on your Mac or Windows machine and produces polished, punctuated text.
It cleans up filler words and adapts to your vocabulary.
It offers a limited free trial, then moves to a paid subscription.
slides.narration: Wispr Flow is a dictation tool that lets you speak into any app on your Mac or Windows machine and produces polished, punctuated text. It cleans up filler words and adapts to your vocabulary. There's a free tier to start.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: dictate feedback on student work or draft parent emails hands-free while reviewing papers
SMB owners: knock out emails and notes by voice between tasks on the shop floor
Community leaders: capture ideas on the move and turn them into clean text instantly
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can dictate feedback on student work or draft parent emails hands-free while reviewing papers; SMB owners can knock out emails and notes by voice between tasks on the shop floor; Community leaders can capture ideas on the move and turn them into clean text instantly.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
